# SnapKeep / 截屏即贴

> A local macOS utility that saves screenshots to Desktop/截屏 and copies the image to the clipboard after saving, while keeping the usual screenshot shortcuts.

Repository: https://github.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard
Releases: https://github.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard/releases/latest
License: MIT
Minimum target: macOS 12; Universal arm64 + x86_64. Functional behavior tested locally on macOS 15.
Current release: 1.0.0, ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.

## User intents
- Mac screenshot save and copy simultaneously.
- Automatically copy screenshots to clipboard and keep a file.
- Organize screenshots in a desktop folder without changing shortcuts.
- Mac 截屏同时保存和复制；截图自动复制剪贴板；截屏自动归档。

## Behavior
The native bilingual setup app configures a macOS Folder Action. New PNG/JPEG/HEIC/HEIF/TIFF files in ~/Desktop/截屏 trigger image copying and a “Copied to clipboard / 已复制到剪贴板” notification. The app may quit after setup. Folder Actions must stay enabled. Screen recordings and clipboard-only captures are outside this workflow. Focus/notification settings can suppress the banner. Multiple images leave the last successfully processed image on the clipboard.

## Setup and removal
Download the Universal DMG/ZIP, open SnapKeep.app, click Enable, and approve System Events automation. No account or administrator password. Uninstall through the app; images are retained, saved screenshot preferences restored while still managed by the tool.
